format.mem: one value per line, two's complement hex, digits = ceil(bits/4)
format.channel: AWGN 10.0 dB on the unit-power 64-QAM symbols, seed 20260928; rx_symbols = receiver output Q10 (12 bit) per symbol [I,Q]
format.latent_pairing: NHWC stream order: symbol k = NHWC elements (2k, 2k+1) = channels (2j, 2j+1) of one pixel = (I, Q); rx_in (NHWC) is the same element sequence
format.latent_idx: per symbol [I level, Q level], level 0..7 <-> (2*level-7)/sqrt(42)

phy_interface.word: AXI-Stream, one symbol per beat, tdata[23:0] = {Q[11:0], I[11:0]}, Q10 two's complement, valid/ready backpressure; encoder tlast = last symbol of the frame

arithmetic.rsr(v,k): k>0: (v + 2^(k-1)) >>> k (arithmetic);  k=0: v;  k<0: v << -k
arithmetic.conv: acc = sum(x*w) + bias (<=48b); act on acc: relu -> max(acc,0), leaky -> acc<0 ? rsr(acc,7) : acc; y = satA(rsr(sat27(rsr(acc, pre[c])) * M[c], sh[c]))
arithmetic.add: y = satA(rsr(a*Ma + b*Mb, sh)); relu after the shift if relu
arithmetic.gate: ag = rsr(a*g, 16); y = satA(rsr(x*Ma + ag*Mb, sh))
arithmetic.gdn/igdn: x2 = rsr(x*x, x2_shift); D = (sum_j gamma[i][j]*x2_j + beta[i]) << L; r = floor(sqrt(D)); gdn: t = sign(x)*floor(|x|*2^F / r); igdn: t = x*r; y = satA(rsr(sat27(rsr(t, pre))*M, sh))
arithmetic.sigmoid: u=|z|; v = rsr(u*to_q312_M, to_q312_sh); if v >= 2^15: g=65536 else seg = v >> offset_bits, off = v & (2^offset_bits-1), g = clamp(c0[seg] + rsr(c1[seg]*off, shift), 0, 65536); z<0: g = 65536 - g   (g in Q0.16, 17 bit unsigned)
arithmetic.qam: per latent element: level = number of thresholds t with x > t (0..7)

ops.pairing: NHWC stream order: symbol = channels (2j, 2j+1) of one pixel = (I, Q)
